potential_clients.summary: Flow Company met with SIT, a Medicare enrollment business, to address lead management and workflow automation challenges. The team identified issues with manual lead qualification, unclear pipeline stages causing missed follow-ups, and integration problems between the Retire Flow platform and Go High Level that create significant manual work. They discussed streamlining pipeline stages by adding an attempting contact stage, automating transitions and messaging, and better utilizing Go High Level's document management features instead of storing client documents manually in conversations. The goal is to automate the enrollment workflow to save 3-5 hours weekly and prevent lost leads, while addressing inconsistent task usage and improving the distinction between waiting on client versus waiting on eligibility determination.
action_items: Follow up with Retire Flow support team to fix integration issues with Go High Level platform to reduce manual work and improve data syncing.
Continue manually assigning leads and opportunities in Go High Level while system automation is being developed and improved.
Organize pipeline stages to clearly separate waiting on client from waiting on eligibility or determination to improve follow-up efficiency and clarify actionable opportunities.
Review meeting notes captured by AI notetaker and analyze current Go High Level system usage.
potential_clients.likelihood_reason: Meeting held to address workflow challenges, but focused on fixing integration issues rather than commitment.
